ios.desc:
WHY CAN'T YOU STOP EATING JUNK FOOD?
It's not a willpower problem. Your favorite snacks were scientifically engineered to keep you coming back. CraveLab reveals exactly how — and gives you a personalized plan to break free.

SCAN ANY FOOD. SEE THE TRUTH.
Point your camera at any food or barcode and instantly get its addiction score. CraveLab's AI breaks down which ingredients, flavor combinations, and chemical tricks are hijacking your brain's dopamine system.

INGREDIENT ANALYZER
Snap any ingredient label and our AI decodes every additive, flavor enhancer, and hidden craving trigger — in plain language, no chemistry degree required.

AI CRAVING COACH
Chat directly with your personal AI coach about your cravings, triggers, and eating habits. Get real answers tailored to you — not generic advice. Whether it's late-night snacking, sugar dependency, or emotional eating, your coach meets you where you are.

BREAKING FREE CHALLENGES
Take on daily challenges to cut junk food one step at a time. Track your streak, check in every day, and watch your brain rewire itself. Every day you show up, the habit gets weaker.

FOOD BATTLE
Compare any two foods head-to-head and see exactly which one is more addictive — and why. Knowledge is your weapon.

DAILY RESET
Every day brings a new perspective on your relationship with food. Small mindset shifts add up to big changes.

LEARN
Food science explained simply. Understand exactly how ultra-processed food companies engineer cravings — so you can stop falling for it.

SCAN HISTORY
Review every food you've scanned. Track what you've been eating and see your patterns over time.

THE SCIENCE BEHIND YOUR CRAVINGS
Ultra-processed foods are specifically designed to override your fullness signals and trigger repeat eating. CraveLab teaches you the neuroscience of food addiction in plain language so you can fight back with knowledge, not just willpower.

WHO IS CRAVELAB FOR?
— You eat healthy most of the time but can't kick junk food
— You've tried willpower and it hasn't worked
— You want to understand your cravings, not just suppress them
— You're curious about what food companies don't want you to know

FAQS
Is CraveLab just another food scanner?
No. CraveLab is the only app that analyzes food through the lens of addiction science — not just nutrition labels.

What is an addiction score?
A 1-10 rating based on ingredients known to trigger dopamine, bliss point engineering, and compulsive eating patterns.

Does it work on any food?
